ET today NEW HAVEN, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nov. 09, 2026-- Veradermics, Incorporated (NYSE: MANE), a dermatologist-founded, late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapeutics for pattern hair loss, today announced positive topline results from Part B of its randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, registration-directed Phase 2/3 clinical trial (Study ‘302’) evaluating VDPHL01, an investigational, proprietary, extended-release oral minoxidil formulation, in over 500 males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

These positive results, combined with previously reported positive topline findings from Study ‘302’ Part A and Phase 3 Study ‘304’ Part A, position VDPHL01 to potentially become the first FDA-approved oral pill in nearly 30 years for pattern hair loss and a potential new treatment option for the 50 million men with pattern hair loss in the U.S.

In October 2026, Veradermics announced positive topline results from Part A of its randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 Study ‘304’ evaluating VDPHL01 in over 500 males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss which represented the completion of all planned placebo-controlled data for male pattern hair loss.
